meta.title: The Rise | Christchurch Central City
meta.description: Six residences on a narrow central-city site: a ground-floor garden apartment beside a residents' wellness suite, and five full-floor three-bedroom homes above it. The approved red-brick character, Concept M footprint and original lift and stair core are retained.

hero.subheader: Six residences on a narrow central-city site: a ground-floor garden apartment beside a residents' wellness suite, and five full-floor three-bedroom homes above it. The approved red-brick character, Concept M footprint and original lift and stair core are retained.

points: Six residences, one per upper floor
Full-floor penthouse with an open west balcony
Ground-floor sauna, spa garden, gym and lounge
10 x 3 m west balcony on every upper floor
Four car stacker positions, up to eight spaces (to be confirmed)
intro.architecture: Red brick, dark framed glazing, pale balcony edges and restrained cedar accents.
